description: Run a short JavaScript program (ES2023 in a QuickJS sandbox: no Node, files, network or timers) that drives the game through the bridge, instead of many tool calls; top-level await and return work. API: `await mc.call(method, params)` calls a bridge tool by name or RPC method (mc.call("get_self") = mc.call("player.getState")); every bridge tool is also a helper with the same parameters and checks, e.g. `await mc.get_self()`, `await mc.find_blocks({ center, radius, blockIds })`, `await mc.break_block({ x, y, z })`. supervised_* tools are refused. A failed call throws an Error with `code` (e.g. capability_disabled) and `data`; the mod's enable* locks apply. `mc.log(...)` / console.log record output, `await mc.sleep(ms)` waits, `mc.args` holds args. Return a JSON value as the result. Limits: timeoutSeconds (default 60, max 300), 64 MiB memory, 2000 calls, 5 s of computation between awaits, 16 KB of log. A failed or stopped script makes no more calls and movement, navigation and mining are released. One script at a time, never during an agent job. Keep a program that worked with save_skill.

args.description: JSON value the program reads as mc.args.

code.description: The program: the body of an async function.

timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock limit of the run in seconds (default 60, max 300).

name: run_script
title: Run a script
